standard_prerequisites: derived pushforward along a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of algebraic spaces
derived tensor and derived pullback and their compatibility under f^*
commutation of Rf_* with direct sums for complexes with quasi-coherent cohomology
the affine equivalence D(A) tilde-equivalent D_QCoh(O_Y) and the P-resolution remark reducing to shifts of the structure sheaf
core_obligations: Prove the projection formula Rf_*E tensor K = Rf_*(E tensor Lf^*K) for E, K in the quasi-coherent derived categories
proof_roadmap: Construct the canonical map as the adjoint of Lf^*(Rf_*E tensor K) = Lf^*Rf_*E tensor Lf^*K to E tensor Lf^*K via the counit Lf^*Rf_*E to E
Check isomorphism etale locally, reducing to Y affine

Observe the property is preserved under direct sums (all three functors commute with sums in the quasi-coherent setting) and under gluing along distinguished triangles (exact functors of triangulated categories)
On affine Y the tilde equivalence plus the P-resolution remark reduce the claim to K = A[k], where both sides are visibly isomorphic
difficulty_reason: H2: a projection formula assembled from functorial compatibilities and a dévissage to shifts of O; the source writes the reduction in full.
